description: The optional word RECORD after the record-name (or FILE file-name) of a REWRITE statement - a COBOL-2002 addition read from the printed formats: §1985:VII.4.5.2 (sequential) and §1985:IX.4.6.2 (relative and indexed) print REWRITE record-name-1 [FROM identifier-1] with no word RECORD, and the ISO/IEC 1989:2002 format (14.8.33.1) prints RECORD, not underlined, after the braces, as §2023:14.9.35.2 does. WRITE refuses its own RECORD word below 2002 the same way. kb/Work PB5159. Gated in ONE place, VersionConformancePass.ParseArm.VisitRewriteStatement (VCR row 7.52).
display: the word RECORD after the record-name of a REWRITE statement
citation: ISO §2023:14.9.35.2; §1985:VII.4.5.2 and §1985:IX.4.6.2 print no word RECORD; the ISO/IEC 1989:2002 text 14.8.33.1 does
vcr: VCR Table 7 row 7.52 (e) - REWRITE ... RECORD, read from the printed formats
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMRWR.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT F ASSIGN TO "VMRWR" ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD F.
01 R PIC X(5).
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W PIC X(5) VALUE "NEW01".
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN I-O F.
    REWRITE R RECORD FROM W.
    CLOSE F.
    STOP RUN.
